hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook for Uniswap v4 that implements a concentrated liquidity curve backed by Euler Finance vaults. Swaps are handled entirely in `beforeSwap` via `beforeSwapReturnsDelta`, depositing input assets into and withdrawing output assets from Euler vaults while verifying a custom curve invariant. Standard Uniswap v4 liquidity positions and donations are blocked; the hook serves as the sole liquidity source.
